what_you_believe_happened: Signed in as accounts.audit, opened Money > Books & cash and clicked 'Add supplier bill'. The page showed 'Loading bill form...' and a red toast 'filePreviewsHtml is not defined'; the form never appeared (it stayed on loading, then vanished/closed on later attempts, also after refresh). Tried the + quick-create menu ('Cost or purchase') and Budgets and costs > '+ New expense / PO': both open a simple 'Record expense or purchase' form with only Project, Type, Description, Amount, Vendor/supplier and 'Send for approval' - no invoice number, bill date, GST or TDS fields, so SH-2041 with 18% GST and 1% TDS could not be entered. Nothing was submitted. Ledger & setup tab was not relevant.
incorrect_navigation_attempts: + quick-create menu > Cost or purchase (expense form, no GST/TDS)
Budgets and costs > New expense / PO (same expense form)
Ledger & setup tab (ledger/reimbursement tools, not bill entry)
unnecessary_steps: Repeated clicks on Add supplier bill and page refresh hoping the form would load
confusing_terminology: Cost or purchase / Record expense or purchase / Add supplier bill -> several entry points with different forms and no hint which is for a vendor invoice
Send for approval -> unclear what happens next
Type: Incurred expense -> unclear vs bill
missing_feedback: 'Loading bill form...' never resolves and nothing says it failed
No indication the Add supplier bill button toggles; button label changes to 'Close bill form' then reverts

observations: The Books page already showed Shree Tiles Pvt Ltd with a Rs 80,000 balance, so the vendor exists. The intended bill form (presumably with GST/TDS) is unreachable due to a script error, and the alternative expense forms lack required fields.
